newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sets terms to spin off NCR unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sets terms to spin off NCR unit - WSJ.

text.p: AT&T Corp has set the terms to spin off its NCR Corp and distribute the unit's common shares to AT&T shareholders on December 31, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the spin off will complete AT&T's break up into three companies, leaving AT&T solely in communication services.
It said AT&T's board of directors approved on Wednesday the stock distribution plan, which will give one new NCR share to AT&T shareholders who as of December 13 hold at least 16 AT&T shares.
It will give cash to those who own less than 16 shares, it said.
The newspaper said the plan will leave AT&T shareholders with about 101 million NCR common shares.

NCR, which will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "NCR," will begin trading on a when-issued basis on December 11, while actual trading of its shares by holders will start after December 31.
